overview: Today's briefing covers key national and international developments alongside targeted updates for the commercial real estate, San Francisco, and Hawaii sectors. General news features stories on housing protests in Spain, international diplomatic talks, and a historic ocean liner's final voyage. Commercial real estate markets continue to see active financing and asset transactions across the country. San Francisco news highlights local policy changes regarding home restaurants and rising legal demand driven by local tech trends. In Hawaii, important updates include commercial recovery milestones in Maui and legal developments on Kauai.

items.title: Clashes in Barcelona as thousands join Spain general strike
items.summary: Tens of thousands of people joined a general strike in Spain called by main unions over housing and the high cost of living.

items.title: The S.S. United States, a Historic Supership, Heads to the Ocean Floor
items.summary: The 20th-century ocean liner S.S. United States is heading to the ocean floor to become an artificial reef.

items.title: Russia-Ukraine talks turn to post-war security but end without breakthrough
items.summary: Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi centered around Europe's security framework but ended without a breakthrough.

items.title: CP Group-Led JV Lands $272M for Mixed-Use Boca Raton Campus
items.summary: A CP Group-led joint venture secured $271.5 million in financing from a Blackstone affiliate for the Mizner Park complex in Boca Raton.

items.title: Goodman Capital Leads $31M Condo Inventory Loan on Seattle-Area Resi Tower

items.title: RFR Seals $101M Refi on Downtown Miami Office Building
items.summary: RFR sealed a $101 million loan provided by Derby Lane Partners and Axonic Capital to refinance a Downtown Miami office building.

items.title: Lawyers are seeing a ‘stunning’ rise in prenups this year — and more postnups too
items.summary: San Francisco family lawyers report a stunning rise in prenups and postnups driven by the AI boom and looming IPOs.

items.title: San Francisco legalizes home restaurants, a win for city’s street vendors
items.summary: San Francisco legalized home restaurants, allowing vendors to prepare food at home and sell it directly or via carts and stands.

items.title: New Lahaina marketplace restores businesses by Front Street
items.summary: The 'Ulu o Lele Marketplace opened on the former Outlets of Maui site, marking a major milestone in Lahaina's commercial recovery.

items.title: ‘Free Palestine’ Stickers Get Librarian Criminally Convicted On Kauaʻi
items.summary: A Kauai librarian received a criminal conviction after placing a pro-Palestine sticker at a local falafel business.

wiki.title: U.S. Route 101
wiki.extract: U.S. Route 101, or U.S. Highway 101 (US 101), is a major north–south highway that traverses the states of California, Oregon, and Washington on the West Coast of the United States. It is part of the United States Numbered Highway System and runs for over 1,500 miles (2,400 km) along the Pacific Ocean. The highway is also known by various names, including El Camino Real in parts of California, the Oregon Coast Highway, and the Olympic Highway in Washington. Despite its three-digit number, normally used for spur routes, US 101 is classified as a primary route with 10 as its "first digit".
